_source: Zambian OBC 2013 Religious Education (2044), Grade 10 — subject code 'RE2044', distinct from the already-bundled 2046 edition (code 'RE'). Rebuilt 2026-08-31 (superseding this file's earlier same-day version, whose sub-topics were too coarse to match the app's 30 pre-existing real embedded lesson plans) from a real, complete Google Drive document, 'RE 2044 SCHEMES OF WORK 10-12.docx' — a genuine week-by-week Scheme of Work covering all three grades and all three terms, from a real Zambian secondary school (a different real school from every other RE 2044 source used so far). Real PII stripped, per standing sourcing policy: the document's final line credited a real named individual and named the source school/town/province; none of that appears anywhere in this file. Sub-topics are now broken down at the same fine grain the lesson plans use ('X in Present Situation' / 'X in African Tradition' / 'X in the Church' / 'X in the Old/New Testament'), with names matching those lesson plans exactly (minus their numeric code prefix, e.g. lesson plan '10.1.1 Work in Present Situation' -> this file's sub-topic 'Work in Present Situation'), so the app's topic/sub-topic matching engine reconnects them. Each sub-topic's week_number is the real week it was FIRST introduced in the source term (not every week it was reviewed/continued); where a sub-topic's content spans two consecutive source weeks (e.g. Work in Present Situation, weeks 1-2), only the first week is recorded. Irregularity documented transparently, not silently corrected: the lesson plans' own numbering assigns 'Service and Authority in the Old/New Testament' (10.4.4/10.4.5) to Grade 10, but this school's real scheme of work shows Grade 10's own Term 3 running out of weeks after 'Service in the Church' (week 10-11) — those two sub-topics were, in the real record, actually taught in the first weeks of Grade 11 Term 1 (as a review/carryover before that grade's own 'Life' theme begins at week 5) rather than within a Grade 10 term. They are placed here (matching the lesson plans' own Grade-10 labeling, since the app's matching engine keys off the lesson plan's declared grade level) at week 12-13 of Grade 10 Term 3 as the most honest available placement, with their real content/reference data drawn from where they actually appear in the source (Grade 11 Term 1, weeks 2-4) — see religious_education_2044_grade11.json's own _source note for the matching cross-reference. Term-2 Justice weeks 7-11 continue directly into Term-3 weeks 1-4 (Old/New Testament) in the source; that reflects the source's own topic pacing, not an error.
